entities.name: Brochfael ab Elisedd
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brochfael ab Elisedd was a king of Powys in the mid-8th century, who inherited the throne from his father, Elisedd ap Gwylog. Upon his death, he was succeeded by his son, Cadell ap Brochfael. His name also was inscribed in the Pillar of Eliseg.
